prompt:
A stunning ultra-photorealistic extreme close-up selfie of a youthful Korean woman with naturally soft, balanced facial features and an elegant feminine appearance. Her complexion is exceptionally clear and luminous, featuring healthy, dewy glass skin with subtle natural pores and a delicate pearlescent glow that looks realistic rather than artificial. She has large warm dark-brown eyes with crisp natural catchlights, long curled black eyelashes, softly shaped natural brows, a fresh rosy blush across the cheeks, a gentle pink flush on the bridge and tip of the nose, and soft gradient rosy-pink lips finished with a light glossy sheen. Her makeup is refined, lightweight, and seamlessly blended in a modern Korean beauty style.
Her body proportions appear natural and graceful with smooth, fair skin. Her light milk-tea brown hair is tied back into a relaxed ponytail using an ivory-white hair tie, while wispy baby hairs and loose face-framing strands soften her features. Multiple delicate piercings decorate her right ear (left side of the image), including the lobe and upper helix, adorned with tiny crystal star and floral earrings. Around her neck rests a fine rose-gold necklace featuring a minimalist white "Z"-inspired pendant enclosed within a slim gold frame.
The photo is taken inside a modern car, with a grey fabric seat visible behind her and a black seatbelt crossing the lower-right portion of the frame, subtly reinforcing the vehicle interior. She is centred in the composition, filling almost the entire frame while holding her phone for a selfie. Her head is noticeably tilted toward the right side of the image, maintaining confident direct eye contact with a calm, captivating expression.
She wears a crisp white collared shirt with the top buttons casually undone, revealing her neckline and collarbones in a refined, effortless way. Bright natural sunlight pours through the windshield, creating clean, directional lighting that enhances the radiance of her skin, adds dimensional highlights to her hair, and produces realistic contrast across her face. The lighting has the authentic look of daylight reflected naturally from the phone and surroundings.
Captured with an eye-level smartphone camera using a subtle Dutch angle that complements the head tilt, the composition focuses almost entirely on her face, neck, and shoulders, with very little background visible. promptZh:
一张令人惊艳的超写实极近距离自拍，主角是一位年轻的 韩国 女性，拥有自然柔和、比例协调的面部特征和优雅的女性气质。她的肤色极其清透亮泽，呈现出健康的水光肌质感，带有细微的自然毛孔和精致的珍珠光泽，看起来真实而不做作。她拥有一双温暖的深棕色大眼睛，眼神中带有清晰的自然反光，睫毛卷翘修长，眉形自然柔和，脸颊透着清新的玫瑰色红晕，鼻梁和鼻尖泛着淡淡的粉色，嘴唇呈现出柔和的渐变玫瑰粉色，并带有轻微的光泽感。她的妆容精致轻薄，完美融合了现代韩式美学风格。
她的身体比例自然优雅，皮肤白皙细腻。她将奶茶棕色的头发扎成一个随性的马尾，用象牙白色的发圈固定，额前的碎发和脸颊两侧的散发柔化了她的面部轮廓。她的右耳（画面左侧）佩戴着多个精致的耳饰，包括耳垂和上耳廓，装饰着细小的水晶星星和花朵耳环。颈间佩戴着一条精致的玫瑰金项链，吊坠是一个简约的白色“Z”字形设计，外围包裹着纤细的金色边框。
照片拍摄于 现代汽车 内部，身后可见灰色织物座椅，右下角有黑色安全带穿过，巧妙地强化了车内环境。她位于构图中心，几乎填满了整个画面，手持手机进行自拍。她的头部明显向画面右侧倾斜，保持着自信的直视目光，表情平静而迷人。
她穿着一件干练的 白色翻领衬衫，领口顶部的扣子随意解开，自然地展现出颈部和锁骨线条，显得精致而随性。明亮的自然光透过挡风玻璃倾泻而入，形成干净的定向光，增强了皮肤的光泽感，为头发增添了立体高光，并在脸上产生真实的对比度。光影效果呈现出手机和周围环境自然反射的真实日光质感。
使用平视视角的智能手机摄像头拍摄，并采用了与头部倾斜相呼应的微小荷兰式倾斜构图，画面几乎完全聚焦于她的面部、颈部和肩部，背景可见度极低。超写实皮肤纹理、电影级色彩科学、真实 HDR、高端智能手机摄影、超清晰细节、浅景深、真实的 iPhone 拍摄画质、8K 分辨率、9:16 纵横比。
